headline.text: Asked for alternatives and a way back in some tasks, pass/fail in one

observations.text: In project planning, the user asked to see the alternatives and what would be given up before deciding.
For a routine test result, the user asked only to be told whether it passed.
For a high-risk migration, the user asked for the failure cases and a way back before approving.

interpretation.text: In these records, the user asked for more when a decision or approval was coming, and for less on a routine result. Their own words in J5 fit this: they want enough to judge what to do.

structured_output.alternative: The difference may come from something else, such as how much the user already knew about each topic or how much time they had. A pending decision may not be the reason.
structured_output.limitation: The records do not say what was at stake in the test result, or why the user asked each way. So we cannot tell whether the decision is what mattered.
